en: {rival}
Gah! The Shadow Triad... What are they? One second we were on deck, the next we're standing out here!
And the ship's leaving! Team Plasma, get back here! You still have my sister's Purrloin!
Cheren
The Shadow Triad... They can hold a person still and disappear in the blink of an eye. But it's Zinzolin who worries me.
A ship that freezes everything it passes, and a plan to turn Unova to ice. Something big is coming, {player}.
There's something I want to look into. I'm going on to Route 6. Be careful out there.
Cheren
{player}! I hardly knew you. You've come a long way since our battle in Aspertia. So has {rival}.
{rival}
Cheren came to see the tournament hall. It's not even open yet and there's already a crowd!
Grunt
Out of the way, out of the way!
{rival}
That uniform... Team Plasma! He's running for that ship at the end of the pier!
I'm going after him! {player}, come with me!
Colress
Wait. Children have no business running headlong into something so dangerous.
{rival}
The Pokémon I'm looking for, my little sister's Purrloin... It might be on that ship! I'm not waiting!
Cheren
I'm going too. Someone has to keep him out of trouble!
Colress
Recklessness, not courage. Do they believe anything is possible simply because they have Pokémon with them?
...Or perhaps that is exactly the force I keep looking for. Go on, then. I would very much like to see what you do.
